US-01-04 is done on feature/US-01-04: 2 commits, not pushed. As the coordinator asked mid-run, I based the branch on origin/main after PR #8 merged (I had made no commits before that). The branch uses the shared helpers in tests/unit/deck-criteria.ts and tests/unit/age-suitability-record.js and does not copy them.

What changed:
- New deck: /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/src/content/decks/5-plus.json, with 50 open questions in Polish and English. Kinds: educational 12, popular-science 13, nature 13, trivia 12.
- The deck is registered with one import line in /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/src/content/decks/index.ts.
- Age-suitability record, one row per question with the near misses checked: /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/docs/delivery/content-checks/US-01-04-5-plus.md
- Tests: /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/tests/unit/AC-01-04-1 to AC-01-04-6. Derived specs: /Users/sulo/workspace/knowledge-quiz/docs/delivery/tests/AC-01-04-1 to AC-01-04-6.
- DEC-51 is appended after DEC-50 in DECISIONS.md. The story and its BACKLOG row are now in-progress.

Adversarial pass:
- I checked all 50 questions myself in both languages and fixed two phrasings.
- An independent reviewer subagent then attacked the draft. It found one blocking problem: in 5p-25 (thunder), Polish "piorun" is also a correct answer. I replaced that question with an atlas question.
- I applied its minor fixes too: wording in 5p-35, 5p-40, 5p-44 and 5p-45, a wrong near-miss note in 5p-41, and two questions that were too easy (5p-05, 5p-07) replaced by harder ones.
- An og:spec-compliance-reviewer pass found all 6 criteria met and nothing blocking.

The acceptance run used the local emulator API 32 (AVD Medium_Phone), which I started before `yarn test:acceptance` and stopped afterwards. It ran on the clean head aaf37b3 with a snapshot.
